Game Overview

At its heart, Cozy Pizzeria is a restaurant game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Cozy Pizzeria keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Cozy Pizzeria?

Cozy Pizzeria is a free restaurant game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Cozy Pizzeria free to play?

Yes, Cozy Pizzeria is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
